turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: (laughs) Ah, the age-old debate about pineapple on a hot dog. I love it. While there isn't a single "proven fact" that settles this, research does suggest that sweetness can balance out savory flavors. Think about it - we often pair sweet and savory flavors in foods like BBQ sauce or teriyaki chicken. But when it comes to pineapple on a hot dog, it's largely a matter of personal preference. How do you think cultural background and individual experiences influence our willingness to try unconventional food combinations?
